sentences.text: Today we are going to talk about a city in Vietnam.
The name of the city is Hanoi.
Hanoi is a very special city.
It is the capital city of Vietnam.
It is in the north of the country.
It is one of the most important cities in Vietnam.
More than 8 million people live in Hanoi.
Hanoi is a city with a long history.
It is over 1,000 years old.
That is very old.
Many kings and emperors lived there a long time ago.
Today, Hanoi is still a very important place.
The government of Vietnam is in Hanoi.
The president lives there.
Many important decisions are made in this city.
Hanoi is a busy city.
There are many people.
There are many motorbikes.
There are cars, buses, shops, and markets.
But there are also quiet places like lakes and temples.
Let me tell you about some famous places in Hanoi.
First, there is Hoan Kim Lake.
It is in the center of the city.
People like to walk around the lake.
In the morning, people do exercise there.
Some people do tai chi, a slow and calm sport.
You can see Turtle Tower in the middle of the lake.
There is also a small island with a red bridge.
The bridge is called the Hook Bridge.
It goes to Ngoc San Temple, a small and beautiful temple.
Another important place is the Ho Chi Minh mausoleum.
Ho Chi Minh was the leader of Vietnam.
He is loved by many people.
At the mausoleum, people come to say thank you and show respect.
Nearby, there is also the Presidential Palace, the One Pillar Pagoda, and Ho Chi Minh's house on stilts.
There is also the Temple of Literature.
It is a very old school.
It was the first university in Vietnam.
It started in the year 1070.
It is a quiet place with old buildings, trees, and flowers.
Many students go there to pray for good luck in school.
Another great place is the Old Quarter.
The Old Quarter is a part of Hanoi with many small streets.
The streets are busy and full of life.
There are small shops and people selling food.
Each street has a name.
Some streets sell shoes.
Some streets sell silver.
Some streets sell paper or toys.
The Old Quarter is very colorful.
Now let's talk about food.
The food in Hanoi is very tasty.
One of the most famous dishes is pho.
Pho is a soup with rice noodles, meat, and herbs.
People eat pho for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
Another food is bun cha.
It has grilled pork, noodles, fresh herbs, and a sweet sauce.
It is very delicious.
There is also chaka, a fish dish cooked with turmeric and dill.
You can also eat spring rolls, sticky rice, and egg coffee.
Yes, that's right.
Egg coffee.
It is a coffee with sweet egg yolk on top.
It is creamy and sweet.
In Hanoi, you can also drink iced tea, sugarcane juice, and fresh coconut water.
There are many street food stalls and small restaurants.
You can sit on a small plastic chair and enjoy your meal.
Let's talk about transportation.
In Hanoi, most people ride motorbikes.
There are also buses, cars, and bicycles.
The traffic is very busy.
There are many motorbikes on the streets.
Sometimes it looks crazy, but it works.
The weather in Hanoi is different in each season.
In summer, it is hot and rainy.
In autumn, the weather is cooler and dry.
In winter, it can be cold and foggy.
Sometimes people wear jackets and scarves.
In spring, the flowers bloom and the weather is warm and nice.
Hanoi is also a city of festivals.
The most important festival is Tet, the Vietnamese New Year.
It is in January or February.
Before Tet, people clean their homes and prepare food.
They buy flowers and fruits.
They wear new clothes.
They visit family and give red envelopes with money.
There are also Mid -Autumn Festival, National Day, and many local celebrations.
You can see lanterns, music, and dancing in the streets.
People in Hanoi are friendly and welcoming.
They like to talk to visitors.
They love their city and their culture.
If you visit Hanoi, you can learn about history, eat good food, and enjoy the local life.
Let's remember what we learned.
Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.
It is old and beautiful.
It has lakes, temples, markets, and museums.
You can eat pho and bun cha.
You can visit the old quarter and the temple of literature.
You can see motorbikes, drink coffee, and enjoy the festivals.
Hanoi is a city full of history, culture, and smiles.
Maybe one day, you can visit Hanoi too.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emily.
I hope you learned something new today.
